quizzes.npcDescription: Middle-aged woman with curly perm, apron, slapping table with wet rag
dialogueSequence: Aigoo~ You ate EVERYTHING! Even the side dishes I refilled 3 times!

*slaps wet rag on table*
45,000 won total. Six of you ate.

choices.text: Let's split it equally on KakaoPay
I'll just pay for what I ordered...

quizzes.wrongFeedback: Aigoo~ splitting the bill? In Korea, someone always treats! Next time they'll get you back. That's how we do it!
quizzes.correctFeedback: That's the spirit! 내가 쏔 culture is how Koreans build deep friendships. They'll get the next one!

quizzes.npcDescription: Young person in blue uniform, dead eyes, one earbud dangling
dialogueSequence: Samgak-gimbap... banana milk... hot bar... That's 4,500 won.

choices.text: *pulls eco-bag from mysterious pocket dimension* No thanks.

quizzes.wrongFeedback: Plastic bags cost 100 won in Korea and come with severe judgmental looks from the ajumma behind you. Eco-bags spawn from nowhere!
quizzes.correctFeedback: Every Korean has a crumpled eco-bag materializing from their pocket at the exact moment needed. You're learning!

quizzes.npcDescription: Full Bukhansan hiking gear, visor, vest, hiking poles, tangerine in pocket
dialogueSequence: *An ajumma in FULL hiking gear parks next to you*

*LOUD sigh*
요즘 젖은 것들... (These days, young people...)
quizzes.dialogue: She's eyeing you. What do you do?

choices.text: Avoid eye contact, pretend to be asleep
Put on headphones and turn up the K-pop
Excuse me, halmeoni. Can I help you with your bag?

quizzes.wrongFeedback: She was testing you! In Korea, proactively helping elders is deeply respected. You missed a free tangerine opportunity.
quizzes.correctFeedback: She hands you a tangerine from her pocket. This is the highest honor. You've been adopted by a Korean grandma!

transformation.title: Tongue Transformation!
transformation.description:
The tiger can no longer pronounce 'TH'!
"Three" → "Seuree"

quizzes.npcDescription: Wrinkled suit, loosened tie, red face, empty soju bottles everywhere
dialogueSequence:
*It's 11:47 PM on a Tuesday.*
*Your flight is at 6 AM.*

*팀장님 slams empty soju bottle*
*Standing up, swaying slightly*

1차 끝났다! 2차! 노래방 가자!!
(Round 1 done! Round 2! KARAOKE!)
quizzes.dialogue: Everyone's looking at you. What do you say?

choices.text: I really should go, I have an early flight...
*check phone nervously* Maybe... one more hour?

quizzes.wrongFeedback: Leaving early from 회식? Bold. In Korean work culture, 2차 is where real bonding happens. Your promotion just walked out the door.
quizzes.correctFeedback: That's the spirit! 회식 culture is sacred. You'll sleep on the plane. Your team loyalty rating just went through the roof!

transformation.title: Hair Transformation!
transformation.description: The tiger's hair turned jet black!

quizzes.npcDescription: Bucket hat, oversized vintage tee, oat milk flat white, film camera
dialogueSequence:
*Instagram-worthy cafe in Seongsu-dong*
*Everything is concrete and exposed brick*
*Friend adjusts bucket hat, takes photo of latte art*
quizzes.dialogue: Oh btw, road trip this weekend. Don't you NOT like jjimjilbang?
quizzes.wrongFeedback: Korean double-negative brain twister! "Don't you NOT like X?" → Answering "No" = "No, that's wrong, I DO like it." Your brain needs more kimchi.
quizzes.correctFeedback: You've cracked the Korean double-negative code! "No" = "That statement is wrong, I DO like it!" Your brain is now wired in Korean!

transformation.title: Final Transformation!
transformation.description: The tiger now bows reflexively 20 times a day!
